codon_counts.name: Number of sense codons per amino acid (standard genetic code)
codon_counts.reference: Saravanan V. & Gautham N. (2015). Harnessing computational biology for exact linear B-cell epitope prediction: a novel amino acid composition-based feature descriptor. OMICS, 19(10), 648-658.
codon_counts.source_note: Standard genetic code (NCBI translation table 1), 61 sense codons, as used for the DDE theoretical mean; 2026-10-12.

atomic_formulas.name: Molecular formulas of the free amino acids
atomic_formulas.reference: Pande A. et al. (2023). Computing wide range of protein/peptide features from their sequence and structure. J Comput Biol, 30(2), 204-222.
atomic_formulas.source_note: Standard free amino-acid formulas; cross-checked against Pfeature's Standalone/Data/atom.csv. Pfeature sums free amino-acid formulas without removing water (protpy's default convention). Its table over-counts H by one for W (C11H13N2O2) and Y (C9H12NO3); the correct formulas C11H12N2O2 and C9H11NO3 are used here, so W/Y-containing sequences differ slightly from Pfeature output. Transcribed 2026-10-12.

pka_sets.name: pKa sets for isoelectric point / charge calculations
pka_sets.reference: protpy: v1.4 defaults. emboss: Rice P. et al. (2000) EMBOSS, Trends Genet 16(6):276-277. bjellqvist: Bjellqvist B. et al. (1993) Electrophoresis 14:1023-1031 and (1994) Electrophoresis 15:529-539. ipc_protein: Kozlowski L.P. (2016) IPC - Isoelectric Point Calculator. Biol Direct 11:55.
pka_sets.source_note: Transcribed programmatically 2026-10-12. emboss: EMBOSS 6.6.0 data file emboss/data/Epk.dat (values only; N_term 7.5, whereas Kozlowski 2016 Table 1 lists 8.6 for EMBOSS). ipc_protein: Table 1 of Kozlowski 2016 (PMC5075173). bjellqvist: Biopython IsoelectricPoint.py tables (attribution; BSD-3), cross-checked against the Bjellqvist row of Kozlowski 2016 Table 1; residue-specific terminal values from Bjellqvist 1994 via Biopython.

n_end_half_life.name: N-end rule half-life (hours) by N-terminal residue
n_end_half_life.reference: Bachmair A. et al. (1986) Science 234:179-186 (mammalian reticulocytes, yeast); Gonda D.K. et al. (1989) J Biol Chem 264:16700-16712; Tobias J.W. et al. (1991) Science 254:1374-1377 (E. coli); as tabulated by ExPASy ProtParam (Gasteiger et al. 2005).
n_end_half_life.source_note: Table 'amino acids and the corresponding half-life' of https://web.expasy.org/protparam/protparam-doc.html, parsed 2026-10-12. Minutes converted to hours. Lower bounds ('>20 hour', '>10 hour') are stored as the bound; the E. coli value for Pro is '?' in the source and stored as null.
